title: Leaving Canada? What Happens to Your TFSA, RRSP and Investments
secondaryQueries: what happens to my tfsa if i leave canada
infoGain: Worked example of one emigrant's four accounts ($310,000 total) showing only the $80,000 non-registered account triggers departure tax on a $30,000 deemed gain, the T1161 and T1244 thresholds applied, and Part XIII 25% withholding ($37,500) on the RRSP versus 30% resident withholding ($45,000).
